name: grove
description: Grove's own skills, published from the repository that implements them — orchestrating a fleet of coding-agent workspaces, working inside one, and configuring and updating Grove itself.

plugins.name: grove
plugins.description: Grove's own skills, published from the repository that implements them. Four skills: using-grove (orchestrate a fleet of isolated agent workspaces from outside — CLI verbs, MCP tool ids, ticket and PR linking and the live status comment it turns on), working-in-grove (report task phase from inside a workspace and keep every attached ticket current), configuring-grove (the config cascade, agents, init scripts, containers, ticket providers and the issue-ops mirror), and reinstalling-grove (when an update did not take).
